annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems (UK retained version, as amended)
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems (UK retained version, as amended)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission; UK legislation.gov.uk (King's Printer), as amended by The Unmanned Aircraft (Amendment) Regulations 2025
annotation.summary_en: UK-retained version of the EU Delegated Regulation 2019/945, as amended by the Unmanned Aircraft (Amendment) Regulations 2025. It sets product requirements for drones (classes UK0–UK6) in the open category, economic operator duties, UK marking, conformity assessment and approved bodies, market surveillance, certification triggers, and third-country operator rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Drones in open category must meet class-specific technical requirements (UK0–UK6) including mass, height limits, geo-awareness, remote ID.
Manufacturers, importers and distributors have conformity, documentation, marking and traceability duties.
Conformity assessment via internal control, type examination or full quality assurance; approved bodies replace EU notified bodies.
Certification required for drones carrying people, dangerous goods, or large drones over assemblies of people.
Market surveillance authorities may require corrective action, withdrawal or recall of risky products.
